name: Peninsula Gardens | 1g Pre-Roll | Pink Sourz
description: Bred in house at Peninsula Gardens by @Trichome_Jones. Pink Runtz x Sour Rozay. The male selected adds a nice load of purple from the Rozay and a bit of funk from the Sour Dubb. Still has a nice candy flavor too it from the Pink Runtz but with a nice funky twist provided by the Sour Rozay.
